hook.convey: two 4-digit numbers met in daily life (a stadium crowd on two days, two game scores) → which is more → look at the biggest place first; the same digits in a different order give different numbers

use.hi: Shanivaar ko cricket stadium mein 5260 log aaye, aur Ravivaar ko 5206 log. Kis din zyada log aaye, yeh aaj hum jagah-jagah dekh kar pakka karna seekhenge.
use.en: On Saturday 5260 people came to the cricket stadium, and on Sunday 5206. Today we learn to decide, place by place, which day had more.

use.hi: Video game mein tumhara score 3870 hai aur dost ka score 3807. Dono mein wahi 3, 8, 7 aur 0 hain, phir bhi ek score bada hai. Aaj dekhenge ki kaunsi jagah faisla karti hai.
use.en: In a video game your score is 3870 and your friend's score is 3807. Both have the same 3, 8, 7 and 0, yet one score is bigger. Today we see which place decides.

explain.convey: 999 has only 3 digits; 999 + 1 = 1000, the first number with a thousands place → a 4-digit number beats a 3-digit one, however big the 3-digit one's digits are

point.hi: Dekho, 999 ke saare ank 9 hain, par usme sirf 3 ank hain aur hazaar ki jagah nahi hai. 999 mein 1 aur jodo toh 1000 banta hai, jisme 4 ank hain aur hazaar ki jagah 1 hai. Toh 999 bhi 1000 se chhota hai, chahe uske ank kitne bhi bade hon.
point.en: Look, all the digits of 999 are 9, but it has only 3 digits and no thousands place. Add 1 more to 999 and you get 1000, which has 4 digits and 1 in the thousands place. So even 999 is smaller than 1000, however big its digits are.

prompt.hi: Ab 987 aur 1012 lo. Kaunsa bada hai, 987 ya 1012?
prompt.en: Now take 987 and 1012. Which is bigger, 987 or 1012?

why.hi: 987 ke sirf 3 ank hain, jabki 1012 ke 4 ank hain, toh 1012 bada hai
why.en: like 999 and 1000, 987 has only 3 digits while 1012 has 4

simpler.hi: Pehle ank gino. 987 mein sirf 3 ank hain, aur doosre number mein 4 ank hain, hazaar ki jagah ke saath.
simpler.en: First count the digits. 987 has only 3 digits, and the other number has 4 digits, with a thousands place.

explain.convey: same number of digits → start from the left; thousands equal → hundreds 8 and 3 → the first difference decides; the tens and ones after it change nothing

point.hi: 4815 aur 4392, dono mein 4 ank hain, toh baayein se shuru karo. Hazaar ki jagah dono mein 4, barabar. Sau ki jagah 8 aur 3, yahi pehla farak hai, aur 8 sau, 3 sau se zyada hai. Isliye 4815 bada hai. Dahaai ke 1 aur 9, aur ekai ke 5 aur 2, ab kuch nahi badalte.
point.en: 4815 and 4392 both have 4 digits, so start from the left. In the thousands place both have 4, equal. In the hundreds place 8 and 3: that is the first difference, and 8 hundreds is more than 3 hundreds. So 4815 is bigger. The tens 1 and 9, and the ones 5 and 2, change nothing now.

prompt.hi: Ab 7268 aur 7531 lo. Kaunsa bada hai, 7268 ya 7531?
prompt.en: Now take 7268 and 7531. Which is bigger, 7268 or 7531?

why.hi: hazaar mein dono ke 7 hain, par sau mein 5, 2 se bada hai, toh 7531 bada hai
why.en: like 4815 beat 4392 with 8 hundreds to 3, 7531 is bigger with 5 hundreds to 2

simpler.hi: Dono mein hazaar ka ank ek jaisa hai. Toh agli jagah, sau ke ank milao: jiska sau bada, wahi number bada.
simpler.en: Both have the same thousands digit. So compare the next place, the hundreds: whichever has more hundreds is bigger.

explain.convey: thousands equal, hundreds equal → move one place right to the tens: 4 tens and 7 tens → 2973 is bigger even though its ones digit is smaller

point.hi: 2946 aur 2973 mein hazaar ki jagah dono mein 2, aur sau ki jagah dono mein 9. Dono barabar hain, toh agli jagah, dahaai, dekho: 4 aur 7. 7 dahaai zyada hai, toh 2973 bada hai, bhale hi 2946 ke ekai mein 6 hai aur 2973 ke ekai mein 3.
point.en: In 2946 and 2973 both have 2 in the thousands place and 9 in the hundreds place. Both are equal, so look at the next place, the tens: 4 and 7. 7 tens is more, so 2973 is bigger, even though 2946 has 6 in the ones and 2973 has 3.

prompt.hi: Ab 6158 aur 6183 lo. Kaunsa bada hai, 6158 ya 6183?
prompt.en: Now take 6158 and 6183. Which is bigger, 6158 or 6183?

why.hi: hazaar aur sau barabar hain, par dahaai mein 8, 5 se bada hai, toh 6183 bada hai
why.en: like 2973 beat 2946 on the tens, 6183 is bigger than 6158, with 8 tens to 5

simpler.hi: Hazaar aur sau dono mein barabar hain. Toh dahaai ke ank milao, jiska dahaai bada woh number bada.
simpler.en: Both have the same thousands and hundreds. So compare the tens digits; the one with more tens is bigger.

problem.hi: Video game mein Sohan ka score 6482 hai aur Pooja ka score 6428. Kiska score zyada hai?
problem.en: In a video game, Sohan's score is 6482 and Pooja's score is 6428. Whose score is higher?

givens.hi: Sohan ka score 6482 hai aur Pooja ka score 6428.
givens.en: Sohan's score is 6482 and Pooja's is 6428.

do.en: First look at the thousands place

why.hi: hazaar sabse badi jagah hai, isliye use sabse pehle dekhte hain
why.en: thousands is the biggest place, so we look at it first

simpler.hi: Sabse badi jagah hazaar hai, use pehle dekho. Dono score mein 6 hazaar hain, toh abhi barabar.
simpler.en: Thousands is the biggest place, so look at it first. Both scores have 6 thousands, so they are equal so far.

do.en: Now look at the hundreds place

why.hi: hazaar barabar hon toh faisla agli jagah par chala jaata hai
why.en: when the thousands are equal, the decision moves to the next place

simpler.hi: Hazaar barabar hain, toh agli jagah sau dekho. Dono mein 4 sau hain, phir se barabar.
simpler.en: With equal thousands, look at the next place, hundreds. Both have 4 hundreds, equal again.

prompt.hi: Ab dahaai ki jagah dekho: Sohan ke score mein 8 dahaai, Pooja ke score mein 2 dahaai. Kiska score zyada hai, Sohan ya Pooja?
prompt.en: Now look at the tens place: Sohan's score has 8 tens, Pooja's score has 2 tens. Whose score is higher, Sohan's or Pooja's?

simpler.hi: Ab faisla dahaai karega. 8 dahaai aur 2 dahaai mein jo zyada hai, uska score bada hai.
simpler.en: Now the tens decide. Whoever has more tens, 8 or 2, has the higher score.

why.hi: hazaar aur sau barabar hain, par Sohan ke 6482 mein 8 dahaai, Pooja ke 6428 ke 2 dahaai se zyada hain
why.en: Sohan's 6482 and Pooja's 6428 match until the tens, where 8 is more than 2

answer.hi: Sohan ka score 6482, Pooja ke score 6428 se zyada hai
answer.en: Sohan's score 6482 is higher than Pooja's score 6428

why.hi: pehla farak dahaai ki jagah par hai, aur 8 dahaai, 2 dahaai se zyada hai
why.en: the first difference is in the tens place, and 8 tens is more than 2 tens

prompt.hi: Ek mele mein pehle din 3104 log aaye aur doosre din 3089 log. Kis din zyada log aaye, pehle ya doosre?
prompt.en: At a fair, 3104 people came on the first day and 3089 on the second day. On which day did more people come, the first or the second?

why.hi: pehle din ke 3104 mein 1 sau hai, doosre din ke 3089 mein 0 sau, aur hazaar dono mein 3 hain
why.en: the first day's 3104 has 1 hundred, while the second day's 3089 has 0

simpler.hi: Hazaar ka ank dono mein ek jaisa hai. Ab 3104 aur 3089 mein sau ki jagah ke ank milao.
simpler.en: 3104 and 3089 have the same thousands digit. Now compare their hundreds digits.

prompt.hi: Neha ke paas 1998 rupaye hain, Ravi ke paas 2010 rupaye. Kiske paas zyada rupaye hain, Neha ya Ravi?
prompt.en: Neha has 1998 rupees, Ravi has 2010 rupees. Who has more rupees, Neha or Ravi?

why.hi: Ravi ke 2010 rupaye mein 2 hazaar hain, jabki Neha ke 1998 mein sirf 1 hazaar hai
why.en: 2010 has 2 thousands, while 1998 has only 1 thousand

simpler.hi: Sabse baayen wala hazaar ka ank dekho. 1998 aur 2010 mein jiska hazaar zyada, uske paas zyada rupaye.
simpler.en: Look at the thousands digit on the far left. Whichever of 1998 and 2010 has more thousands has more rupees.

prompt.hi: {friend} ka kehna hai ki 4287 bada hai 4310 se, kyunki aakhri ank 7, 0 se bada hai. Kya yeh sahi hai?
prompt.en: {friend} says 4287 is bigger than 4310, because the last digit 7 is bigger than 0. Is that right?

why.hi: aakhri ank nahi, sau dekho: hazaar barabar hain, par 4310 ka 3, 4287 ke 2 se bada hai, toh 4310 bada hai
why.en: both have 4 thousands, but in the hundreds the 3 of 4310 beats the 2 of 4287, so 4310 is bigger

simpler.hi: Aakhri ank se nahi, baayen se shuru karo. Hazaar barabar hain, toh sau ke ank milao.
simpler.en: Do not start from the last digit, start from the left. The thousands are equal, so compare the hundreds.

999 against 1000 → more digits beats big digits

remediation.move: both numbers as place-value blocks side by side, biggest blocks first: thousand-cubes equal → hundred-flats 2 and 3 → the 87 small blocks can never make up one more hundred

say.hi: Pehle bade blocks dekho: dono mein 4 hazaar, par 4310 mein 3 sau aur 4287 mein sirf 2 sau. Bache 87 chhote blocks milkar bhi ek sau nahi banate.
say.en: Look at the big blocks first: both have 4 thousands, but 4310 has 3 hundreds and 4287 only 2 hundreds. The 87 small blocks left together do not make even one hundred.

simpler.hi: Pehle hazaar dekho, dono mein 4. Phir sau dekho: 4310 mein 3, 4287 mein sirf 2. Isliye 4310 bada hai.
simpler.en: Check the thousands first: both have 4. Then the hundreds: 4310 has 3, 4287 only 2. So 4310 is bigger.

prompt.hi: Isha ke 5196 points hain, Rohit ke 5203 points. Kiske points zyada hain, Isha ya Rohit? Pehle bade blocks dekho.

simpler.en: Look at the big blocks, thousands and hundreds, first. 5196 and 5203 have equal thousands, so compare the hundreds digit.

remediation.move: count on from 1999: one more makes 2000 → 1998 has not reached 2000 yet, 2010 is already past it; both placed against the 2000 mark

say.hi: 1999 mein 1 jodo toh 2000 banta hai, toh 1998 abhi 2000 tak bhi nahi pahuncha. 2010 toh 2000 se bhi aage hai.
say.en: Add 1 to 1999 and you get 2000, so 1998 has not even reached 2000. 2010 is already past 2000.

simpler.hi: 1998 abhi 2000 tak nahi pahuncha, aur 2010 toh 2000 ke aage hai. Isliye 2010 bada hai.
simpler.en: 1998 has not reached 2000, and 2010 is past 2000. So 2010 is bigger.

prompt.hi: Sana ke paas 2995 rupaye hain, Gopi ke paas 3008 rupaye. Kiske paas zyada hain, Sana ya Gopi?

why.hi: Gopi ke 3008 rupaye mein 3 hazaar hain, jabki Sana ke 2995 mein sirf 2 hazaar hain

simpler.en: First of all look at the thousands digit. Whichever of 2995 and 3008 has more thousands is bigger; leave the other digits.

bridgeToNext.hi: Do numbers ki tulna ab aa gayi. Ab chaar numbers ko ek saath kram mein lagayenge, wahi jagah-jagah dekhne ke tarike se.
bridgeToNext.en: Now you can compare two numbers. Next we put four numbers in order together, with the same place-by-place way.

hook.convey: several 4-digit numbers (heights of hill tops, scores on a leaderboard) → line them up smallest to biggest → sort by thousands, then break every tie with the hundreds, then the tens

use.hi: Ek trip mein tum teen pahad dekhte ho, jinki oonchai 2780 m, 2087 m aur 2870 m hai. Inhe sabse chhote se sabse oonche tak kaise lagate hain, aaj yahi seekhenge.

point.hi: In teen numbers 5120, 2984 aur 7036 ki hazaar ki jagah par alag ank hain: 5, 2 aur 7. Toh sirf hazaar dekh kar chhote se bade ka kram ban jaata hai: pehle 2984, phir 5120, aur aakhir mein 7036.
point.en: These three numbers 5120, 2984 and 7036 have different thousands digits: 5, 2 and 7. So the thousands alone put them from smallest to biggest: first 2984, then 5120, and last 7036.

simpler.hi: Teeno numbers ke hazaar ke ank alag-alag hain. Bas hazaar ke ank chhote se bade ke kram mein lagao.

explain.convey: all four have 4 thousands → the thousands decide nothing → hundreds 6, 0, 5, 0 → 4083 and 4091 still tie → their tens 8 and 9 decide

point.hi: Ab 4610, 4083, 4502 aur 4091, sab mein 4 hazaar hain, toh hazaar se faisla nahi hota. Sau ki jagah dekho: 6, 0, 5 aur 0. 4083 aur 4091 dono mein 0 sau hain, toh unke dahaai dekho: 8 aur 9. Chhote se bade ka kram hai 4083, 4091, 4502, 4610.
point.en: Now 4610, 4083, 4502 and 4091 all have 4 thousands, so the thousands do not decide. Look at the hundreds: 6, 0, 5 and 0. 4083 and 4091 both have 0 hundreds, so look at their tens: 8 and 9. The order from smallest to biggest is 4083, 4091, 4502, 4610.

prompt.hi: Ab 2640, 2406 aur 2460 ko bade se chhote ke kram mein lagao.

why.en: just as 1508, 1580, 1805 turned into 1805, 1580, 1508, the 6 hundreds of 2640 comes first: 2640, 2460, 2406

simpler.hi: Pehle chhote se bade ka kram banao. Phir us kram ko ulta padho.

why.hi: aabaadi ke sau 0, 8, 7, 0 hain, aur dahaai mein 8, 7 se bada hai: 4870, 4708, 4087, 4078
why.en: the hundreds are 0, 8, 7, 0, and 8 tens beat 7 tens: 4870, 4708, 4087, 4078

simpler.hi: Teeno mein hazaar barabar hai, toh sau ka ank dekho. Jinka sau bhi barabar ho, unke dahaai milao.
simpler.en: All three have equal thousands, so look at the hundreds digit. Where the hundreds are also equal, compare the tens.

bridgeToNext.hi: Kram mein lagana aa gaya. Ab inhi numbers ko number line par unki sahi doori par rakhenge.

hook.convey: a straight road with a stone every 1000 m, a hill path with a mark every 100 m → every number has its own spot, spaced by its value, not just in order

use.en: On the path up a mountain there is a mark every 100 metres, from 2000 to 3000 metres. Today we see exactly where each height's mark goes.

explain.convey: 0 to 10000 in 10 equal jumps of 1000 → 1000 is the first mark after 0, not the middle; the middle mark is 5000 (5 jumps each side)

point.hi: 0 se 10000 tak ki number line ko 10 barabar chhalaang mein baanto, har chhalaang 1000 ki. Toh 1000, 0 ke baad pehla nishaan hai, beech mein nahi. Beech ka nishaan 5000 hai, kyunki uske ek taraf 5 chhalaang hain aur doosri taraf bhi 5.
point.en: Split the number line from 0 to 10000 into 10 equal jumps, each jump 1000. So 1000 is the 1st mark after 0, not the middle. The middle mark is 5000, because there are 5 jumps on one side of it and 5 on the other.

prompt.hi: Isi 0 se 10000 wali line par 7000 kahan aayega? 0 ke baad kaunsa nishaan, batao.
prompt.en: On this same line from 0 to 10000, where does 7000 go? Which mark after 0?

why.hi: har chhalaang 1000 ki hai, aur 0 se 7000 tak 7 chhalaang lagti hain
why.en: each jump is 1000, and 7 jumps take you from 0 to 7000

simpler.hi: Har chhalaang 1000 ki hai. 0 se 7000 tak kitni chhalaang lagengi, woh gino.
simpler.en: Each jump is 1000. Count how many jumps it takes to go from 0 to 7000.

explain.convey: 1000 to 2000 with 1500 in the middle; 1900 is only 100 from 2000 → near 2000, not in the middle; asked: which of 1400, 1800 is nearer 1500

point.hi: Ab 1000 se 2000 tak ki line lo. Beech mein 1500 aata hai. 1900 toh 2000 se sirf 100 door hai, isliye woh 2000 ke bilkul paas aata hai, beech mein nahi.
point.en: Now take the line from 1000 to 2000. 1500 comes in the middle. 1900 is only 100 away from 2000, so it comes right next to 2000, not in the middle.

prompt.hi: Isi 1000 se 2000 wali line par, 1500 ke zyada paas kaun hai, 1400 ya 1800?
prompt.en: On this same line from 1000 to 2000, which is nearer to 1500, 1400 or 1800?

why.hi: 1400 aur 1500 mein 100 ka farak hai, jabki 1800 aur 1500 mein 300 ka
why.en: on the 1000 to 2000 line, 1400 is 100 from 1500, while 1800 is 300 from it

simpler.hi: 1500 se dono numbers ki doori nikalo. Jo number 1500 se kam door ho, wahi uske paas hai.
simpler.en: Find how far each number is from 1500. The one less far from 1500 is nearer to it.

problem.hi: Ek number line 6000 se 7000 tak hai, aur har 100 par barabar nishaan hain, yaani 10 chhalaang. 6300 aur 6800 mein se 7000 ke zyada paas kaun hai?
problem.en: A number line goes from 6000 to 7000, with equal marks every 100, so 10 jumps. Of 6300 and 6800, which is closer to 7000?

givens.hi: Line 6000 se 7000 tak hai, har 100 par nishaan hai, aur numbers 6300 aur 6800 hain.
givens.en: The line runs from 6000 to 7000 with a mark every 100, and the numbers are 6300 and 6800.

find.hi: 6300 aur 6800 mein se 7000 ke zyada paas kaun hai
find.en: which of 6300 and 6800 is closer to 7000

steps.result: 6000 ke baad teesra nishaan, 7000 se 7 chhalaang door

why.hi: har chhalaang 100 ki hai aur 6300 mein 6000 se 3 sau zyada hain
why.en: each jump is 100 and 6300 is 3 hundreds more than 6000

simpler.hi: Har chhalaang 100 ki hai. 6000 se 6300 tak teen chhalaang hain, toh 6300 teesre nishaan par hai.
simpler.en: Each jump is 100. From 6000 to 6300 there are three jumps, so 6300 is on the third mark.

why.hi: 6800 mein 6000 se 8 sau zyada hain
why.en: 6800 is 8 hundreds more than 6000

simpler.hi: 6000 se 6800 tak aath chhalaang hain. Toh 6800 aathven nishaan par aata hai.
simpler.en: From 6000 to 6800 there are eight jumps. So 6800 comes on the eighth mark.

prompt.hi: Ab 6800 wale nishaan se 7000 tak kitni chhalaang hain?
prompt.en: Now how many jumps are there from the 6800 mark to 7000?

simpler.hi: Poori line mein 10 chhalaang hain. 6800 aathven nishaan par hai, toh 7000 tak bachi hui chhalaang gino.
simpler.en: The whole line has 10 jumps. 6800 is on the eighth mark, so count the jumps left up to 7000.

why.hi: 6000 se 7000 ki line par har nishaan 100 ka hai, aur 6800 se 7000 tak 2 chhalaang hain
why.en: of the 10 jumps of 100, 6300 is 7 from 7000 and 6800 is only 2

answer.hi: 6800, 7000 ke zyada paas hai: woh sirf 2 chhalaang yaani 200 door hai, jabki 6300 poori 7 chhalaang yaani 700 door hai
answer.en: 6800 is closer to 7000: it is only 2 jumps (200) away, while 6300 is 7 jumps (700) away

why.hi: har chhalaang barabar 100 ki hai, isliye kam chhalaang ka matlab kam doori hai
why.en: every jump is the same 100, so fewer jumps means a shorter distance

prompt.hi: Ek number line 2000 se 3000 tak hai, aur uska beech ka nishaan 2500 hai. 2100 kahan aayega, 2000 ke paas ya 2500 ke paas?
prompt.en: A number line goes from 2000 to 3000, and its middle mark is 2500. Where does 2100 go, near 2000 or near 2500?

why.hi: 2100, 2000 se sirf 100 door hai, aur 2500 se 400 door
why.en: on the 2000 to 3000 line, 2100 is only 100 from 2000, but 400 from 2500

simpler.hi: Dekho 2100 ki 2000 se doori kitni hai, aur 2500 se kitni. Jo doori chhoti ho, wahi paas hai.
simpler.en: See how far 2100 is from 2000, and how far from 2500. The smaller distance is the nearer one.

prompt.hi: {friend} ne 0 se 2000 tak ki number line par 200 ko bilkul beech mein lagaya. Kya yeh sahi hai?
prompt.en: {friend} put 200 right in the middle of a number line from 0 to 2000. Is that right?

accept: nahi, 200 toh 0 ke paas aata hai

why.hi: 0 se 2000 ka beech 1000 hai, aur 200 toh 0 ke paas aata hai
why.en: the middle of 0 to 2000 is 1000, and 200 comes near 0

simpler.hi: Beech ka nishaan 0 aur 2000 dono se barabar door hota hai. Dekho, 200 shuru se kitna door hai.
simpler.en: The middle mark is equally far from 0 and 2000. See how far 200 is from the start.

ladder.why: which of two numbers sits closer to the end of a 4000 to 5000 line
predict where 1000 sits on a 0 to 10000 line before marking
fill the blank mark on a line counting in equal steps of 200

remediation.move: mark the halfway point of the line first, then split each half; compare where 200 sits against the halfway mark 1000

say.hi: Pehle beech ka nishaan dhoondo: 0 se 6000 ka beech 3000 hai. Jo number beech se bahut chhota ho, woh 0 ki taraf aata hai.
say.en: First find the middle mark: the middle of 0 to 6000 is 3000. A number much smaller than the middle comes towards 0.

simpler.hi: Beech ka nishaan 3000 hai. Usse bahut chhota number, 0 ki taraf, shuru mein aata hai.
simpler.en: The middle mark is 3000. A number much smaller than it comes near the start, towards 0.

prompt.hi: 0 se 6000 tak ki line par 600 kahan aayega, 0 ke paas ya beech mein?
prompt.en: On a line from 0 to 6000, where does 600 go, near 0 or in the middle?

why.hi: 0 se 6000 ka beech 3000 hai, aur 600, 0 se sirf 600 door hai
why.en: the middle of 0 to 6000 is 3000, and 600 is only 600 from 0

simpler.hi: Beech ka nishaan 0 aur 6000 dono se barabar door hota hai. 600 toh shuru se bas thoda aage hai.
simpler.en: The middle mark is equally far from 0 and 6000. 600 is only a little way past the start.
